**How I planned the shot:** I kept it to one action so the 8 seconds don't overload. The master scrapes one thin curl of wood off a carved pomegranate, then blows the dust off and it lifts into the light beam. The beam comes through an arched window in a black tuff stone wall, which is typical of Gyumri. It starts as front light on him and, as the camera circles, ends up behind him as backlight. The last frame is fixed so the clip ends on a deliberate image.

## FINAL

**Video prompt — Kling 3.0, 8s, 16:9**

**Settings:**
- Mode: Text-to-Video
- Model: Kling 3.0
- Quality: Professional / 1080p
- Duration: 8 s
- Aspect ratio: 16:9
- References: none
- Native audio: ON if your interface has it (otherwise use the Sound line as your post-production list)
- CFG / creativity: default

**Prompt:**
```
Dusk inside an old stone woodcarving workshop in Gyumri, Armenia: quiet, warm, unhurried, the end of a long working day. An Armenian master woodcarver of about seventy, grey stubble, deeply lined face, reading glasses low on his nose, a worn brown leather apron over a faded grey work shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow, sits at a heavy scarred workbench slightly left of centre, body turned three-quarters to camera, eyes down on a walnut panel carved with a pomegranate in relief. Behind him a deep arched window set in a black tufa stone wall faces west; the low sun pushes one hard amber shaft of light diagonally across the bench, and fine sawdust drifts slowly through the beam. The rest of the room falls into cool blue-grey shadow: chisels and gouges hung on a wooden board, pale wood shavings curled on the bench and floor.

He braces the panel with his left hand, sets a small gouge against one pomegranate seed and pushes; a single thin curl of walnut lifts and falls. He pauses, leans in, and blows softly across the carving; a small cloud of sawdust rises into the amber beam and hangs there, glittering. Steady hands, calm focused face, small real movements only.

Camera at eye level, 35mm lens, one slow continuous orbit of about 60 degrees around him, from his front-left to his front-right, smooth and constant, no cuts. As the camera travels, the window beam slides behind him and becomes a rim light on his grey hair, his glasses and the wood curl.

Final frame: medium close-up from his front-right, his hands and the pomegranate panel sharp in the lower frame, his face just above in soft focus, the amber beam directly behind him backlighting the hanging sawdust, the black tufa wall dark at the edges.

Same man, apron, glasses, panel and window throughout; light always comes from the window. Photoreal, natural aged skin with pores and age spots, detailed walnut grain, shallow depth of field, warm amber against cool blue-grey grade, soft film grain, gentle bloom in the beam, 24fps.

Sound: dry scrape of the gouge through walnut, the wood curl dropping on the bench, his soft breath as he blows, faint evening street sounds outside the window. No music, no speech.
```

**Negative prompt:**
```
music, speech, text, subtitles, watermark, logo, cuts, fast camera, shaky camera, extra fingers, warped hands, melting tool, morphing face, plastic skin, cartoon, oversaturated orange, flat lighting, modern power tools
```
